canDoYue: 你識話自己趕唔切東京轉機，改簽今晚九點嗰班，行李一齊轉運，拎三十蚊餐券，去二十二號閘口。
canDoEn: Say a delay made you miss the Tokyo connection, rebook the nine o'clock flight, keep the bag on that flight, take a thirty-dollar voucher, and go to gate twenty-two.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hi. My first flight was delayed, and I've missed my connection to Tokyo.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我第一班機延誤咗，趕唔切去東京嘅轉機。
dialogue.say: Hi. My first flight was delayed, and I've missed my connection to Tokyo.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. Let me check. The next flight to Tokyo leaves at nine tonight.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思。等我查一查。下一班去東京嘅機今晚九點起飛。
dialogue.say: I'm sorry. Let me check. The next flight to Tokyo leaves at nine tonight.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can you rebook me on it? And will my checked bag be transferred?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以幫我改簽上呢班機？我件寄艙行李會唔會轉運？
dialogue.say: Can you rebook me on it? And will my checked bag be transferred?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes, I've rebooked you. Your bag will go on the same flight.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，我已經幫你改簽。你件行李會上同一班機。
dialogue.say: Yes, I've rebooked you. Your bag will go on the same flight.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: It's a long wait. Can I get a meal voucher?
dialogue.glossYue: 等好耐。可唔可以畀張餐券我？
dialogue.say: It's a long wait. Can I get a meal voucher?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes, here's a voucher for thirty dollars. You can use it at any cafe here.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，呢張係三十蚊嘅餐券。你喺呢度任何咖啡店都用得。
dialogue.say: Yes, here's a voucher for thirty dollars. You can use it at any cafe here.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thanks. Which gate does it leave from?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。佢由邊個閘口起飛？
dialogue.say: Thanks. Which gate does it leave from?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Gate twenty-two. Here's your new boarding pass.
dialogue.glossYue: 二十二號閘口。呢張係你嘅新登機證。
dialogue.say: Gate twenty-two. Here's your new boarding pass.
